tenderSchedule.locationName: BMRCL O AND M Wing Contracts office Baiyappanahalli Bengaluru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited, O and M Wing, Baiyappanahalli Depot, SV Road Baiyappanahalli, Bengaluru.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Tenderer should not quote less than the Estimated Tender Total of Rs.89,41,85,704.26 (which includes Wage cost (Incl of GST) and Service Charge at 4.543%) (Incl of GST)). The Tenderers quote should be same or above the estimated Tender Total of. Any Tenderer whose quote is less than the Estimated Tender Total, shall be considered as unresponsive and such quotes will be summarily rejected.

In the event of non-submission of the Undertaking as per Annexure-N of Qualification cum Technical Package, the Tenderer shall be considered Technically Non-Responsive and shall not be considered for further evaluation.

Tenderers have to upload scanned copy / proof of the Pay Order or Bankers Cheque / Demand Draft / BG/e-BG along with the bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to BMRCL within Five (05) days of Bid End Date. Failure to submit the hardcopy of EMD as specifed, the Tender shall be rejected.
All other Terms and Conditions as per Tender Document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience of having successfully completed Security and Allied Services, during last Seven (07) years ending last day of month previous to the one in which Tender is invited should be either of the following. 1. One similar completed service with annualised value not less than the amount equal to Rs.23.85 Crore. Or 2. Two similar completed services with annualised value not less than the amount equal to Rs.14.90 Crore. Or 3.Three similar completed services with annualised value not less than the amount equal to Rs.11.92 Crore. In any Metros/ Railways/ Airports/ Large PSUs/ Nationalized Banks/ Central/ State Government/Large PSUs/Large Private Sectors/ Reputed Organizations.
Should have in the last Five (05) years i.e., 2020-21 to 2024-25 achieved in at least Two (02) Financial years, a minimum Financial Turnover of Rs.59.61 Crore.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: All Other as per Tender terms and Conditions

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: A certifcate from practicing Chartered Accountant shall be enclosed indicating the Turnover of each of Five fnancial years 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 as per Annexure-D of Setion-10
Any Other Documents as Per the Tender Document
Bank Credit line /Letter of Credit/ Certificate from Bank as per Annexure - E at Section - 10. The Bank Certificate shall be specific to this Tender.
Undertaking by the Tenderer for Minimum Tender Total Quote as per Annexure-N

Further the Tenderer shall MANDATORILY submit an UNDERTAKING(ANNEXURE-N) that its Quote is Equal or Above the Estimated Tender Total.
